title: Riemann Hypothesis
statement_short: All nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part 1/2.
why_it_matters: Controls the error term in the prime number theorem; Clay Millennium Problem.
known_partial_results: Verified for the first ~3*10^12 zeros (Platt-Trudgian 2021); >40% of zeros on the line (Conrey; later improvements); Guth-Maynard 2024 improved zero-density estimates.
suggested_attack: Learning only: formalize statement-level infrastructure and known zero-free regions; numerics of zeros as a sanity benchmark.

title: P vs NP
statement_short: Is every language verifiable in polynomial time also decidable in polynomial time?
why_it_matters: Central question of complexity theory; Clay Millennium Problem.
known_partial_results: Known barriers: relativization (Baker-Gill-Solovay), natural proofs (Razborov-Rudich), algebrization (Aaronson-Wigderson).
suggested_attack: Learning only: track circuit lower bound literature; formalize barrier theorems as a Lean exercise.

title: Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness
statement_short: Do smooth finite-energy initial data for 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes always yield global smooth solutions (or can blowup occur)?
why_it_matters: Clay Millennium Problem; foundations of fluid mechanics.
known_partial_results: Tao 2016 blowup for an averaged NS; Buckmaster-Vicol non-uniqueness of weak solutions; Chen-Hou computer-assisted blowup for 3D Euler with boundary; 2025 DeepMind/academic work on unstable self-similar singularities via physics-informed networks (reported, partly preprint).
suggested_attack: Follow computer-assisted blowup program (candidate singularity found numerically, then rigorous interval-arithmetic proof); physics-agent monitors.

title: Yang-Mills existence and mass gap
statement_short: Construct a 4D quantum Yang-Mills theory on R^4 for compact simple gauge group satisfying Wightman-type axioms, and prove a positive mass gap.
why_it_matters: Clay Millennium Problem; would make QCD-type gauge theory mathematically rigorous.
known_partial_results: Rigorous constructions known in 2D and partially 3D; lattice gauge theory results (Chatterjee and others) on Wilson loops and large-N limits; 4D continuum open.
suggested_attack: Learning only; physics-agent tracks lattice/probabilistic approaches.

title: Hodge Conjecture
statement_short: On a projective non-singular complex variety, every rational Hodge class is a rational combination of classes of algebraic cycles.
why_it_matters: Clay Millennium Problem; links topology and algebraic geometry.
known_partial_results: Known for (1,1)-classes (Lefschetz (1,1) theorem) and hence for dim<=3 consequences; false with integer coefficients (Atiyah-Hirzebruch).
suggested_attack: Learning only.

title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
statement_short: The rank of an elliptic curve over Q equals the order of vanishing of its L-function at s=1 (plus the refined leading-term formula).
why_it_matters: Clay Millennium Problem; governs rational points on elliptic curves.
known_partial_results: Rank 0 and 1 cases known when analytic rank <=1 (Gross-Zagier, Kolyvagin); Bhargava-Shankar: average rank bounded, positive proportion satisfy BSD.
suggested_attack: Learning only; numeric checks via LMFDB are a good data-agent exercise; mathlib elliptic-curve API is growing.

title: Goldbach Conjecture (strong)
statement_short: Every even integer greater than 2 is a sum of two primes.
why_it_matters: Iconic additive prime problem.
known_partial_results: Weak (ternary) Goldbach proved by Helfgott 2013; strong form verified to 4*10^18 (Oliveira e Silva et al.); Chen's theorem (prime + P2).
suggested_attack: Learning only; note Helfgott's ternary proof is a (very large) formalization candidate.

title: Twin Prime Conjecture
statement_short: There are infinitely many primes p with p+2 also prime.
why_it_matters: Paradigm problem for sieve theory.
known_partial_results: Zhang 2013 bounded gaps; Maynard-Tao; Polymath8b: liminf of prime gaps <= 246 (<=6 under Elliott-Halberstam generalization).
suggested_attack: Learning only; formalizing Maynard's sieve bound is a long-term D-style project.

title: Collatz Conjecture
statement_short: Iterating n -> n/2 (even) or 3n+1 (odd) reaches 1 for every positive integer n.
why_it_matters: Famous simple-to-state problem; benchmark for AI hype vs reality.
known_partial_results: Tao 2019: almost all orbits attain almost bounded values; computationally verified to roughly 2^70 range (Barina, ongoing); Collatz-like Busy Beaver 'cryptids' show related undecidability flavour.
suggested_attack: Learning only; do NOT spend compute on brute-force verification.

title: abc Conjecture (status)
statement_short: For every eps>0, only finitely many coprime a+b=c have c > rad(abc)^(1+eps).
why_it_matters: Implies many Diophantine results (e.g. asymptotic FLT, Mordell).
known_partial_results: Mochizuki's IUT proof claim (2012, published PRIMS 2021) is not accepted by most experts after the Scholze-Stix objection; later claims (e.g. K. Joshi 2024) also unresolved; there has been public discussion of Lean formalization of IUT - status uncertain, verify before citing.
suggested_attack: Learning only; literature-agent maintains an honest status note.

title: Union-closed sets conjecture (Frankl)
statement_short: Every finite union-closed family with a nonempty set has an element in at least half of its sets.
why_it_matters: Classic; recent entropy breakthrough shows AI-adjacent info-theoretic methods matter.
known_partial_results: Gilmer 2022 constant fraction; improved to ~0.38 by Alweiss-Huang-Sellke, Chase-Lovett, Sawin, Yu, Cambie; 1/2 still open.
suggested_attack: Formalize the entropy argument (D-style spinoff); search small families for extremal behaviour.

title: Lonely runner conjecture
statement_short: k runners with distinct constant speeds on a unit circle: each runner is at some time at distance >=1/k from all others.
why_it_matters: Connections to view-obstruction, flows in graphs, chromatic numbers of distance graphs.
known_partial_results: Proved up to 7 runners (Barajas-Serra 2008); 2025 preprints reportedly extend to 8, 9 and 10 runners via computer-assisted arguments - verify status.
suggested_attack: Literature check of 2025 preprints; if valid, formalize the finite reduction + certificate in Lean.

title: Hadwiger conjecture
statement_short: Every graph with no K_t minor is (t-1)-colourable.
why_it_matters: Generalizes the four colour theorem.
known_partial_results: Known for t<=6 (Robertson-Seymour-Thomas, uses 4CT); O(t log log t) colouring (Delcourt-Postle 2021).
suggested_attack: Learning; check counterexample-search literature for small cases.
references: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadwiger_conjecture_(graph_theory);Delcourt-Postle 2021 (reducing linear Hadwiger to coloring small dense subgraphs)

title: Erdős-Hajnal conjecture
statement_short: For every graph H there is c>0 such that every H-free graph on n vertices has a clique or independent set of size n^c.
why_it_matters: Central structural Ramsey question.
known_partial_results: Many special cases proved, incl. P5-free graphs (Nguyen-Scott-Seymour 2023).
suggested_attack: Literature-agent maps smallest open H; analogy-agent looks for transferable techniques.

title: Sunflower conjecture
statement_short: Any family of more than C(r)^k sets of size k contains an r-sunflower.
why_it_matters: Applications in circuit complexity and TCS.
known_partial_results: Alweiss-Lovett-Wu-Zhang 2019: bound (log k)^k type; refinements by Rao, Bell-Chueluecha-Warnke.
suggested_attack: Formalize ALWZ-Rao proof as a D-side project; search small k,r numerically.

title: Inscribed square problem (Toeplitz)
statement_short: Every Jordan curve in the plane contains four points forming a square.
why_it_matters: Old and elementary; partial results use symplectic topology.
known_partial_results: True for smooth, piecewise-analytic, locally monotone curves; Greene-Lobb 2020 rectangles of any aspect ratio for smooth curves; general continuous case open.
suggested_attack: Learning; formalize the smooth-curve proof as a stretch D target.

title: Jacobian conjecture
statement_short: A polynomial map C^n -> C^n with constant nonzero Jacobian determinant has a polynomial inverse.
why_it_matters: Many false proofs; good test of AI rigor.
known_partial_results: Reduced to cubic homogeneous maps (Bass-Connell-Wright, Yagzhev); true for n=2 up to high degree bounds.
suggested_attack: Learning only; useful red-team benchmark for claimed AI proofs.

title: Erdős-Straus conjecture
statement_short: For every n>=2, 4/n = 1/x+1/y+1/z has a solution in positive integers.
why_it_matters: Classic Egyptian-fraction problem.
known_partial_results: Verified to very large n (~10^17); holds for all n outside few residue classes mod 840; Elsholtz-Tao counting results.
suggested_attack: Low priority: computation alone cannot settle it; formalizing residue-class covering is an easy Lean exercise.

title: Moore graph of degree 57
statement_short: Does a Moore graph (diameter 2, girth 5) with degree 57 and 3250 vertices exist?
why_it_matters: Last unresolved case of Hoffman-Singleton theorem.
known_partial_results: Hoffman-Singleton: degrees 2,3,7,57 only possible; if it exists it is not vertex-transitive (Higman), automorphism group small (Mačaj-Širáň).
suggested_attack: Literature + structured search under assumed automorphisms; very low odds.

title: Unit distance problem: true exponent
statement_short: Determine the growth of the maximum number of unit distances among n points in the plane.
why_it_matters: Erdős 1946 conjecture n^{1+o(1)} was reportedly disproved in May 2026 by an OpenAI model; exponent now open between ~1.014 and 4/3.
known_partial_results: Upper bound O(n^{4/3}) (Spencer-Szemeredi-Trotter); 2026 OpenAI construction beat n^{1+o(1)} by a tiny polynomial factor; Sawin pushed to ~n^{1.014}; Alon-Bloom-Wood gave a human-verified digest (verify exact numbers).
suggested_attack: Read arXiv:2605.20695 and companions; try to push the exponent via construction-agent; formalize digest (see D row).

title: Odd perfect numbers
statement_short: Does an odd perfect number exist?
why_it_matters: One of the oldest open problems.
known_partial_results: Any odd perfect number exceeds 10^1500 (Ochem-Rao 2012) and has many structural constraints (Euler form, >=10 distinct prime factors, etc.).
suggested_attack: Learning; formalize Euler's form theorem as a warm-up if not in mathlib.

title: Inverse Galois problem for M23
statement_short: Is the Mathieu group M23 a Galois group over Q?
why_it_matters: Only sporadic simple group not known to be realized over Q.
known_partial_results: All other sporadic groups realized (mostly via rigidity); M23 resists rigidity methods.
suggested_attack: Literature + computational search of polynomial families (Magma/PARI); low odds.

title: Erdős problems sweep (erdosproblems.com)
statement_short: Systematically triage open problems on erdosproblems.com: literature-resolved, AI-tractable, construction-type, or deep.
why_it_matters: Highest-yield known pipeline for AI-assisted results in 2025-2026; several problems resolved by literature search or AI (e.g. GPT-5.2 Pro + Aristotle).
known_partial_results: Many problems had status changes in 2025-2026 via literature discovery and AI proofs; Epoch AI FrontierMath Erdős benchmark (68 significant open problems as of Aug 2026); community wiki tracks AI contributions.
suggested_attack: literature-agent triages 20 problems/week; lean-agent states them in Lean (cross-check google-deepmind/formal-conjectures); report findings to site maintainers.

title: Formal-conjectures contributions
statement_short: Contribute correct Lean 4 statements of open conjectures (Erdős, OEIS, Wikipedia lists) to the formal-conjectures repository.
why_it_matters: Concrete, reviewable output; mis-stated conjectures are a known failure mode, so careful statements are valued.
known_partial_results: Repository launched by Google DeepMind in 2025 with hundreds of statements; open PRs welcome.
suggested_attack: lean-agent drafts statements; literature-agent checks against source; test against known small cases.

title: Ramsey number R(5,5)
statement_short: Determine R(5,5); currently 43 <= R(5,5) <= 46.
why_it_matters: Most famous small Ramsey number.
known_partial_results: Lower bound 43 (Exoo 1989); upper bound 46 (Angeltveit-McKay 2024, large computation); McKay-Radziszowski conjecture R(5,5)=43.
suggested_attack: Do not attack the upper bound directly; instead study (5,5)-good graphs on 42 vertices and verify catalogue claims.

title: Ramsey number R(3,10)
statement_short: Determine R(3,10); known 40 <= R(3,10) <= 41 (verify latest).
why_it_matters: Smallest open two-colour Ramsey number of form R(3,k); one-step gap.
known_partial_results: Lower bound 40 (Exoo 1989); upper bound improved to 41 by Angeltveit (2023/24 preprint, computer-assisted) - verify.
suggested_attack: SAT/graph-search for triangle-free graphs on 40 vertices with independence number <10; or try to close the upper bound with gluing methods.

title: Multicolour Ramsey R(3,3,3,3)
statement_short: Determine the 4-colour triangle Ramsey number; known 51 <= R(3,3,3,3) <= 62.
why_it_matters: Gap is wide; lower bound via explicit constructions is a natural AI search target.
known_partial_results: Lower 51 (Chung 1973); upper 62 (Fettes-Kramer-Radziszowski 2004).
suggested_attack: construction-agent: search 4-colourings of K_51 without monochromatic triangles (improve to 52 = new result); use Schur-like and cyclic structures.

title: Schur number S(6) bounds
statement_short: Largest n such that {1..n} can be partitioned into 6 sum-free sets; known 536 <= S(6) <= 1836.
why_it_matters: S(5)=160 was settled by a 2PB SAT proof (Heule 2017); S(6) lower bound open to search.
suggested_attack: construction-agent: symmetric/template search to beat 536; also weak Schur numbers.

title: Van der Waerden numbers: new lower bounds
title_he: מספרי ון דר וורדן: חסמים תחתונים
statement_short: Improve lower bounds for unknown W(r,k) (e.g. W(2,7), W(3,5), W(4,4)) by explicit colourings.
why_it_matters: Constructions are checkable certificates; prior records came from structured search (Rabung, cyclic zipping).
known_partial_results: Exact values known only for few cases (e.g. W(2,6)=1132, Kouril-Paul 2008); tables of lower bounds by Rabung-Lotts, Herwig et al., Monroe.
suggested_attack: construction-agent: cyclic/power-residue colourings + local search; any new record is publishable as a short note with certificate.

title: Cap sets in F_3^n (sizes and capacity)
statement_short: Find larger cap sets in small dimensions (max size open for n>=7) and improve the asymptotic capacity lower bound.
why_it_matters: Flagship FunSearch result; direct benchmark for our search stack.
known_partial_results: Max size known up to n=6 (112, Potechin 2008); FunSearch found a 512-cap in n=8 and capacity lower bound ~2.2202; upper bound 2.756^n (Ellenberg-Gijswijt).
suggested_attack: Reproduce FunSearch with open models (OpenEvolve-style), then target n=7 lower bound and admissible-set constructions for capacity.

title: Kissing numbers: lower bounds in dims 10-31
statement_short: Find larger kissing configurations in dimensions where exact values are unknown.
why_it_matters: Active AI vs human race 2025-2026 (AlphaEvolve 593 in dim 11; Ganzhinov; PackingStar dims 25-31; Cohn-Li dims 17-21).
known_partial_results: Exact known only in dims 1,2,3,4,8,24; 2025-2026 records changed in dims 10,11,14,17-21,25-31 - pull current table before claiming.
suggested_attack: Check Cohn's table; target dimensions with stale records; certify via exact or rational coordinates.

title: Hadwiger-Nelson problem (chromatic number of the plane)
statement_short: Chromatic number of the plane is in {5,6,7}; find smaller 5-chromatic unit-distance graphs or progress toward 6.
why_it_matters: De Grey 2018 breakthrough came from computer search; Polymath16 found smaller graphs.
known_partial_results: 5 <= chi <= 7 (de Grey 2018); smallest known 5-chromatic unit-distance graph has 509 vertices (Parts 2020); related bounds for plane colourings with restricted tiles.
suggested_attack: SAT-guided search for smaller 5-chromatic UDGs; 6-chromatic would be a major result.

title: Heilbronn triangle problem (small n)
statement_short: Place n points in a unit square/triangle/disk maximizing the minimum triangle area; optimal configurations unknown for most n.
why_it_matters: AlphaEvolve improved some small-n records in 2025; natural continuous optimisation target.
known_partial_results: Optimal known for n<=8 or so in the square; AlphaEvolve reported improved configurations for some cases (see results repo).
suggested_attack: Gradient + evolutionary search; certify with exact arithmetic.

title: Erdős minimum overlap problem
statement_short: Determine the limiting constant M in Erdős's minimum overlap problem (known 0.379005 <= M <= ~0.3809).
why_it_matters: AlphaEvolve improved the upper bound slightly in 2025; step-function optimisation.
known_partial_results: Lower bound 0.379005 (White 2022); upper bound improved by Haugland 2016, then AlphaEvolve 2025 (~0.380924) - verify current value.
suggested_attack: Large-scale step-function optimisation; rigorous verification via exact rationals.

title: Autocorrelation / Sidon-type constants
statement_short: Improve bounds for autoconvolution inequality constants (e.g. sup of f*f for nonnegative f with integral 1).
why_it_matters: Several were improved by AlphaEvolve and follow-ups; easy-to-verify numerical certificates.
known_partial_results: Bounds by Matolcsi-Vinuesa, Cloninger-Steinerberger; 2025 AlphaEvolve improvements on some constants.
suggested_attack: Optimisation over step functions + LP duality for lower bounds.

title: Circle and polygon packing records
statement_short: Improve best-known packings (circles in square, unit hexagons in hexagon, etc.) for specific n.
why_it_matters: Packomania tables; AlphaEvolve beat some records (hexagons n=11,12); clean benchmark.
known_partial_results: Records tracked on Packomania (Specht); optimality proven only for small n.
suggested_attack: Global optimisation + basin hopping; prioritize sizes with old records.

title: Largest sum-free subset constant
statement_short: Every set of n integers has a sum-free subset of size n/3 + f(n); determine growth of f.
why_it_matters: Erdős problem; Bedert 2025 proved f(n) >= c log log n, upper bound much larger.
known_partial_results: Bourgain: (n+2)/3; Bedert 2025: n/3 + c log log n; upper bounds of order o(n) via Eberhard-Green-Manners.
suggested_attack: Literature + construction search for upper-bound examples; formalize Bedert (D row).

title: Sidon sets in [1,N]
statement_short: Maximum Sidon set size in {1..N} is N^{1/2} + O(N^{1/4}); improve the second-order term.
why_it_matters: Erdős prize problem.
known_partial_results: Upper bound N^{1/2}+0.998N^{1/4} (Balogh-Füredi-Roy 2021), later small improvements; lower via Singer/Bose constructions.
suggested_attack: Computational exploration of optimal Sidon sets for moderate N (known tables); look for patterns.

title: Crossing number of K_13 (Hill conjecture)
statement_short: Hill conjecture predicts cr(K_n) = 1/4 floor(n/2)floor((n-1)/2)floor((n-2)/2)floor((n-3)/2); verified for n<=12.
why_it_matters: Next case K_13 is a concrete computational frontier.
known_partial_results: Proved for n<=12 (Pan-Richter 2007); asymptotic lower bounds via flag algebras/SDP (de Klerk et al.).
suggested_attack: SAT/ILP over rotation systems with symmetry; check recent preprints first.

title: Conway's 99-graph problem
statement_short: Does a strongly regular graph srg(99,14,1,2) exist?
why_it_matters: Conway $1000 prize; clean yes/no with a certificate if yes.
known_partial_results: Many structural constraints; no example known.
suggested_attack: Search under assumed automorphism groups; literature-agent collects nonexistence constraints.

title: Hadamard matrix of order 668
statement_short: Construct a Hadamard matrix of order 668 (smallest unknown order).
why_it_matters: Hadamard conjecture; a single construction is a definitive, publishable result.
known_partial_results: Hadamard matrices known for all orders 4k < 668 (order 428 found by Kharaghani-Tayfeh-Rezaie 2005).
suggested_attack: Search Goethals-Seidel/Williamson-type arrays with symmetry assumptions; very hard but certificate-checkable.

title: Turán density of K_4^(3)
statement_short: Determine pi(K_4^(3)); Turán conjectured 5/9.
why_it_matters: Flag-algebra SDP bounds are computational and verifiable.
known_partial_results: Upper bound ~0.5617 via flag algebras (Razborov; Baber-Talbot); many extremal constructions (Brown, Kostochka, Fon-der-Flaass).
suggested_attack: Reproduce flag-algebra SDP; explore new extremal constructions with search.

title: No-three-in-line problem
statement_short: Can 2n points with no three collinear always be placed in an n x n grid for all large n?
why_it_matters: Solutions known up to n=46; conjectured to fail for large n.
known_partial_results: 2n achievable for n<=46 (Flammenkamp); Guy-Kelly heuristic suggests ~c n asymptotically with c<2.
suggested_attack: Extend search to n=47+ with symmetry constraints; certificates are trivially checkable in Lean.

title: Erdős-Szekeres happy ending for hexagon+1 (ES(7))
statement_short: Prove that every 33 points in general position contain a convex heptagon (ES(7)=33, conjectured 2^{n-2}+1).
why_it_matters: ES(6)=17 was proven by computer (Szekeres-Peters 2006); empty hexagon h(6)=30 was SAT-solved and Lean-verified 2024.
known_partial_results: ES(n)=2^{n-2}+1 proven for n<=6; Suk 2017 asymptotic 2^{n+o(n)}.
suggested_attack: Study the SAT encoding used for empty hexagon (Heule-Scheucher) and assess feasibility for ES(7).

title: OEIS conjecture mining
statement_short: Scan OEIS entries containing 'Conjecture:' and triage which are provable, refutable by computation, or already known.
why_it_matters: Large pool of small open statements; good for proving/disproving with AI + Lean.
known_partial_results: Prior automated efforts (e.g. Ramanujan Machine-style conjecture generation, LLM-based OEIS work); many conjectures are easy, some deep.
suggested_attack: Automated pipeline: extract, test numerically to large N, attempt proof; publish batch results.

title: Erdős-Gyárfás conjecture
statement_short: Every graph with minimum degree >=3 contains a cycle whose length is a power of 2.
why_it_matters: Counterexample search is natural for AI; verified for small graphs.
known_partial_results: Holds for claw-free graphs, planar cubic graphs (Heckman-Krakovski); any counterexample has >=17 vertices (and larger bounds for cubic graphs).
suggested_attack: Exhaustive/guided search on cubic graphs; literature check of verification bounds.

title: Snake-in-the-box records
statement_short: Longest induced path (snake) in the hypercube Q_n; exact known up to n=8.
why_it_matters: Long-standing record table improved by heuristic and evolutionary search.
known_partial_results: Exact for n<=8 (n=8 by Östergård-Pettersson 2014); lower bounds for n>=9 improved incrementally.
suggested_attack: Monte-Carlo tree search / evolution; certificates are simple.

title: Busy Beaver BB(6) cryptids
statement_short: Decide halting for remaining 6-state Turing machines; several are Collatz-like 'cryptids'.
why_it_matters: BB(5)=47,176,870 was proved with Coq in 2024 by the bbchallenge collaboration; community is AI-friendly.
known_partial_results: BB(5) settled 2024; BB(6) has huge lower bounds and unresolved machines (e.g. Antihydra).
suggested_attack: Write and formally verify new deciders; join bbchallenge.

title: Spherical codes and covering codes tables
statement_short: Improve best known spherical codes (Sloane tables) and covering/constant-weight code records.
why_it_matters: Large public tables; every improvement is a checkable record.
known_partial_results: Tables by Sloane (spherical codes), Brouwer (constant-weight codes), Kéri (covering codes).
suggested_attack: Optimisation sweeps on stale entries; exact verification.

title: Small Ramsey-type numbers in Lean via SAT certificates (S(4)=44, W(3,3)=27, W(2,4)=35)
title_he: מספרי רמזי קטנים ב-Lean עם תעודות SAT
statement_short: Produce sorry-free Lean 4 proofs of exact small Schur/van der Waerden values, using verified LRAT checking or bv_decide-style tactics.
why_it_matters: Warm-up that builds the SAT->Lean pipeline needed for every C-tier result; check whether already done first.
known_partial_results: Values long known (Baumert 1965; Chvátal 1970); Lean 4 has verified LRAT checking (LeanSAT / bv_decide); empty hexagon h(6)=30 verified in Lean 2024 as a template.
suggested_attack: Week 1 literature check; encode; generate LRAT; check in Lean; publish repo + short note.

title: R(4,5)=25 in Lean
statement_short: Formalize R(4,5)=25 (McKay-Radziszowski 1995) in Lean 4.
why_it_matters: Formally verified in HOL4 (Gauthier-Brown 2024); a Lean version would be a strong pipeline demonstration.
known_partial_results: HOL4 proof by Gauthier and Brown 2024 used large SAT computations.
suggested_attack: Reuse the HOL4 decomposition; port certificates; requires serious compute.

title: Formalize recently AI-solved Erdős problems
title_he: פורמליזציה של בעיות ארדש שנפתרו לאחרונה בעזרת AI
statement_short: Pick Erdős problems resolved 2025-2026 (e.g. #728 reported solved by GPT-5.2 Pro, Jan 2026) whose proofs lack a Lean formalization, and formalize them.
why_it_matters: Verification closes the trust gap on AI-claimed results; short proofs, high visibility.
known_partial_results: Several AI solutions were already Lean-checked (e.g. via Harmonic's Aristotle); check the community wiki for which are not.
suggested_attack: literature-agent lists candidates with proof length; lean-agent formalizes the shortest unformalized ones.

title: Unit-distance counterexample (2026) in Lean
statement_short: Formalize the Alon-Bloom-Wood digest of the May 2026 OpenAI construction disproving the n^{1+o(1)} unit-distance conjecture.
why_it_matters: Highest-profile AI math result of 2026; a Lean proof would be widely noticed.
known_partial_results: Human-verified digest exists; uses algebraic number theory that may be partially missing in mathlib - check whether someone has already formalized it.
suggested_attack: Assess mathlib prerequisites first; blueprint; split into lemmas.

title: 5-chromatic unit-distance graph verified in Lean
statement_short: Formally verify that the plane is not 4-colourable via an explicit unit-distance graph (exact coordinates + non-4-colourability certificate).
why_it_matters: Turns de Grey's computer-assisted theorem into a kernel-checked one.
known_partial_results: De Grey 2018 and Polymath16 graphs (smallest known 509 vertices, Parts); unit distances in Q(sqrt3, sqrt5, ...) need exact algebraic arithmetic.
suggested_attack: Encode coordinates in a number field; decide distances by norm computations; SAT certificate via LRAT.

title: Gilmer union-closed bound in Lean
title_he: חסם גילמר לקבוצות סגורות לאיחוד ב-Lean
statement_short: Formalize a constant-fraction bound for Frankl's conjecture (Gilmer 2022 / ~0.38 refinements).
why_it_matters: Entropy infrastructure exists from the PFR project; short, celebrated proof.
known_partial_results: Proof is a few pages; check for existing Lean formalizations before starting.
suggested_attack: Reuse PFR entropy API; aim for the 0.38 constant if feasible.

title: Bedert's sum-free theorem (2025) in Lean
title_he: משפט בדרט על קבוצות חסרות סכום ב-Lean
statement_short: Formalize Bedert's 2025 result that every n-element integer set has a sum-free subset of size n/3 + c log log n.
why_it_matters: Resolves a long-standing Erdős question; fresh, unlikely to be formalized yet.
known_partial_results: Uses Fourier analysis on Z (Littlewood-type L1 norm bounds); mathlib has partial Fourier infrastructure.
suggested_attack: Blueprint first; identify missing analytic lemmas.

title: Cap set bound (Ellenberg-Gijswijt) in mathlib
statement_short: Port the Ellenberg-Gijswijt cap set upper bound to Lean 4 / mathlib.
why_it_matters: Lean 3 formalization exists (Dahmen-Hölzl-Lewis 2019); check whether a Lean 4/mathlib port already landed.
known_partial_results: Lean 3 proof available; polynomial method infrastructure in mathlib.
suggested_attack: If not ported: port and upstream to mathlib; good first mathlib PR.

title: Missing theorems from Freek's 100 list in Lean
statement_short: Formalize items on the '100 theorems' list not yet done in Lean/mathlib.
why_it_matters: Public scoreboard; each item closed is a recognizable contribution.
known_partial_results: Lean community maintains a missing list; remaining items tend to be geometry/analysis-heavy.
suggested_attack: lean-agent picks the item with the best prerequisite coverage; coordinate on Zulip.

title: Kuratowski's theorem in mathlib
statement_short: Formalize planarity and Kuratowski/Wagner theorem in Lean 4.
why_it_matters: Graph planarity is a known gap in mathlib; unlocks many graph results.
known_partial_results: Proved 1930; formalized in other systems (e.g. Isabelle); mathlib planarity API minimal - verify current state.
suggested_attack: Choose combinatorial definition (rotation systems) to avoid topology; blueprint.

title: Sylvester-Gallai theorem
statement_short: Formalize: finitely many non-collinear points in the plane determine an ordinary line (Kelly's proof).
why_it_matters: Short, classical, good warm-up; check mathlib/Archive first.
known_partial_results: Proofs by Kelly, Melchior; Green-Tao on ordinary lines count.
suggested_attack: Kelly's minimal-distance argument in Lean's Euclidean geometry API.

title: Kneser graph chromatic number (Lovász)
statement_short: Formalize chi(KG(n,k)) = n-2k+2 via a combinatorial proof (Matoušek's Tucker-lemma route).
why_it_matters: Gateway to topological combinatorics in Lean.
known_partial_results: Lovász 1978; combinatorial proof by Matoušek 2004; Tucker's lemma has combinatorial proofs.
suggested_attack: Formalize Tucker's lemma combinatorially, then Kneser.

title: Busy Beaver BB(5) proof port to Lean
statement_short: Port (parts of) the Coq proof BB(5)=47,176,870 to Lean 4.
why_it_matters: Cross-system verification of a celebrated 2024 collaborative result.
known_partial_results: Full Coq proof by bbchallenge (2024); some Lean decider work exists in the community - check.
suggested_attack: Port deciders one at a time; reuse certificates.

title: Contribute to the FLT formalization project
statement_short: Take open blueprint nodes in Kevin Buzzard's Lean FLT project.
why_it_matters: Long-term flagship; blueprint nodes are well-scoped units of work.
known_partial_results: Project ongoing since 2024; many nodes completed; check the blueprint for open tasks.
suggested_attack: lean-agent claims small nodes via Zulip; good apprenticeship.

title: Moving sofa problem (Baek 2024) - verification
statement_short: Baek (2024) claims Gerver's sofa (area ~2.2195) is optimal; formalize or computer-check key lemmas.
why_it_matters: Claimed resolution of a 1966 problem; long proof, verification valuable.
known_partial_results: arXiv preprint ~100+ pages; acceptance status in refereed venue - verify.
suggested_attack: Start by formalizing the problem statement and Gerver's construction area; then pick lemmas.

title: Four colour theorem in Lean
statement_short: Port the Gonthier Coq proof (or a new verified computation) of the four colour theorem to Lean 4.
why_it_matters: Iconic computer-assisted theorem; depends on planarity infrastructure (see Kuratowski row).
known_partial_results: Coq proof complete (Gonthier 2005); Lean efforts reported - check status.
suggested_attack: Long-term; first build planar map API.

title: Bunkbed conjecture counterexample verification
statement_short: Formally verify the 2024 counterexample to the bunkbed conjecture (Gladkov-Pak-Zimin).
why_it_matters: A disproved conjecture whose counterexample needs exact probability bounds - good test of verified computation.
known_partial_results: Counterexample built via Hollom's hypergraph counterexample; probability gap is tiny.
suggested_attack: Assess whether exact rational computation is feasible; else verify the reduction lemmas.

title: 3D Euler/Navier-Stokes computer-assisted blowup
statement_short: Find and rigorously prove finite-time singularities for 3D Euler (no boundary) or related models using numerics + interval arithmetic.
why_it_matters: Concrete pathway toward the Navier-Stokes Millennium problem.
known_partial_results: Chen-Hou 2022/23: rigorous blowup for 3D axisymmetric Euler with boundary (Hou-Luo scenario); 2025 work on unstable self-similar solutions using PINNs (DeepMind + collaborators, preprint).
suggested_attack: Reproduce PINN self-similar profiles for 1D/2D model equations (e.g. Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos, Boussinesq); learn interval-arithmetic verification.
references: arXiv:2210.07191;Wang et al. 2025 preprint (discovery of unstable singularities with PINNs);https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navier%E2%80%93Stokes_existence_and_smoothness

title: 3D Ising model: rigorous conformal bootstrap bounds
statement_short: Tighten rigorous bounds on 3D Ising critical exponents using numerical conformal bootstrap (SDP).
why_it_matters: No exact solution of 3D Ising; bootstrap gives most precise exponents; computational and verifiable.
known_partial_results: Kos-Poland-Simmons-Duffin-Vichi islands; precision ~1e-6 for Delta_sigma, Delta_epsilon (2016 onward); conditional on CFT assumptions.
suggested_attack: Run SDPB on mixed-correlator systems; reproduce then extend.

title: Smale's 6th problem: finiteness of central configurations
title_he: הבעיה השישית של סמייל: קונפיגורציות מרכזיות
statement_short: Is the number of relative equilibria (central configurations) of the n-body problem finite for any positive masses?
why_it_matters: Smale problem with an algebraic formulation tractable for computer algebra.
known_partial_results: n=4 proved (Hampton-Moeckel 2006); n=5 for generic masses (Albouy-Kaloshin 2012); n>=6 open.
suggested_attack: Tropical/Gröbner methods for n=5 non-generic or n=6 special masses.

title: Haldane conjecture (spin-1 Heisenberg chain gap)
statement_short: Prove the 1D antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chain with integer spin has a spectral gap.
why_it_matters: Nobel-related prediction; math formulation is a spectral gap of an explicit Hamiltonian.
known_partial_results: AKLT model gap proved (1987); numerics strongly support; half-integer spin gapless (Lieb-Schultz-Mattis); finite-size criteria (Knabe, Gosset-Mozgunov) reduce gap to finite computations for some models.
suggested_attack: Try finite-size gap criteria + exact diagonalisation for perturbations of AKLT.
references: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Haldane_conjecture;Gosset-Mozgunov 2016 (local gap threshold for frustration-free spin systems)

title: Area law for 2D gapped ground states
statement_short: Do ground states of gapped local Hamiltonians on 2D lattices satisfy an entanglement area law?
why_it_matters: Underpins tensor-network methods; proven in 1D (Hastings).
known_partial_results: 1D proved (Hastings 2007; Arad-Kitaev-Landau-Vazirani); 2D special cases (frustration-free, local TQO) only.
suggested_attack: Literature tracking; low tractability.

title: Maximal quantum violation of Bell inequalities (e.g. I3322)
title_he: הפרה קוונטית מקסימלית של אי-שוויוני בל
statement_short: Compute the maximal quantum value of specific Bell inequalities such as I3322 and decide whether finite dimensions suffice.
why_it_matters: NPA hierarchy gives SDP upper bounds; constructions give lower bounds - ideal for AI search + SDP.
known_partial_results: I3322 max ~0.25087556 approached in high dimensions (Pál-Vértesi 2010); exact value and dimension requirement open; MIP*=RE shows general undecidability.
suggested_attack: Construction-agent searches explicit states/measurements; physics-agent runs high-level NPA bounds.

title: Lieb-Thirring optimal constant conjecture
statement_short: Determine the optimal constant in the Lieb-Thirring inequality for gamma=1 in d=3 (conjectured semiclassical/one-bound-state value).
why_it_matters: Controls stability of matter estimates.
known_partial_results: Frank-Hundertmark-Jex-Nam 2021 best known constant; Frank-Gontier-Lewin 2021 showed the semiclassical conjecture fails for some gamma.
suggested_attack: Numerical optimisation of potentials to search for counterexamples or confirm.

title: Hilbert's 6th problem: kinetic to fluid derivation
statement_short: Rigorously derive Boltzmann and then fluid equations from Newtonian particle dynamics for long times.
why_it_matters: Axiomatization of physics; recent major progress.
known_partial_results: Deng-Hani-Ma 2025 claimed derivation of Boltzmann (long time) and incompressible Navier-Stokes from hard-sphere dynamics - under review.
suggested_attack: Literature-agent tracks; learning only.

title: Self-avoiding walk: square-lattice connective constant and 3D exponents
statement_short: Determine the square-lattice connective constant and rigorously prove critical exponents (e.g. nu=3/4 in 2D).
why_it_matters: Honeycomb mu=sqrt(2+sqrt2) proved (Duminil-Copin-Smirnov 2012); square lattice unknown in closed form.
known_partial_results: Rigorous bounds on mu(Z^2) from enumeration (Jensen, Clisby) and Kesten-type bounds; exponents proven only in d>=5.
suggested_attack: Improve rigorous upper/lower bounds on mu(Z^2) via transfer-matrix computations.

title: Kerr stability and cosmic censorship
statement_short: Prove nonlinear stability of Kerr black holes for all subextremal spins and (weak/strong) cosmic censorship.
why_it_matters: Central problems of mathematical GR.
known_partial_results: Klainerman-Szeftel (2022, with Giorgi) slowly rotating Kerr stability; Christodoulou's genericity results for spherical scalar field; full problem open.
suggested_attack: Learning only.

title: PhysLean contributions
statement_short: Formalize physics results (e.g. Wick's theorem, anomaly cancellation conditions, Lorentz group facts) in the PhysLean project.
why_it_matters: Physics formalization is young; contributions are accessible and visible.
known_partial_results: PhysLean (formerly HepLean, J. Tooby-Smith) has growing library and listed TODO items.
suggested_attack: lean-agent + physics-agent pick TODO items each sprint.
